title: Sindh Revision of Emoluments of Public Representatives Act 1995

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Revision of Emoluments of Public Representatives Act 1995
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT I OF 1995
ACT I OF 1995
SINDH REVISION OF EMOLUMENTS OF PUBLIC REPRESENTATIVES ACT, 1995
An Act to revise the salaries and
other emoluments of the holders of representative offices in the Province of
Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 30th March, 1995]
No.PAS/Legis-B-5/95, dated
30-3-1995.---The Sindh Revision of Emoluments of Public Representatives Bill,
1995 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 26th March, 1995
and assented to by Governor of Sindh on 28th March, 1995 is hereby published as
an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act my be called the
Sindh Revision of Emoluments of Public Representatives Act, 1995.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of Sindh Act, XXVI of 1974

ACT I OF 1995
ACT I OF 1995
SINDH REVISION OF EMOLUMENTS OF PUBLIC REPRESENTATIVES ACT, 1995
An Act to revise the salaries and
other emoluments of the holders of representative offices in the Province of
Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 30th March, 1995]
No.PAS/Legis-B-5/95, dated
30-3-1995.---The Sindh Revision of Emoluments of Public Representatives Bill,
1995 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 26th March, 1995
and assented to by Governor of Sindh on 28th March, 1995 is hereby published as
an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
2. Amendment of Sindh Act, XXVI of 1974.---The following amendments
shall be made in the Sindh Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974
namely-- .
(1) in section 3, for the words
"two thousand and five hundred", the words "four thousand and
five hundred" shall be substituted;
(2) after section 3, the
following new section shall be inserted--
"3-A.
Sumptuary allowance.---A member
shall receive sumptuary allowance at the rate of two thousand rupees per
month."
(3) for section 4, the following
shall be substituted:--
"4.
Daily allowance and conveyance allowance.---A member shall be entitled to
receive a daily allowance at the rate of four hundred rupees and conveyance
allowance at the rate of two hundred and fifty rupees per diem for the period
of residence on duty and for the day of arrival and the day of departure from
the place where a session of the Assembly or a meeting of Committee is held or
where any other business connected with his duties as such member is
transacted.".
(4) for section 4-A, the
following shall be substituted:---
"4-A.
Subsidy.---A member shall be paid a subsidy at the rate of four hundred and
fifty rupees for each day during the period of residence on duty.
4-B. Accommodation
Allowance.---Where official accommodation is not provided to a member, he
shall be paid an accommodation allowance at the rate of one thousand rupees per
day for the period of residence on duty."
(5) for section 5, the following
shall be substituted:--
"5. Travelling allowance.---(1) For every journey performed for
the purpose of. attending a session or a meeting of a Committee or for
attending to any other business connected with his duties as member from his
usual place of residence to the place where the session or meeting is held or
other business is transacted and for the return journey from such place to his
usual place of residence, a member shall be entitled to receive travelling
allowance at the following rates:--
(a) where the
journey is performed by rail, an amount equal to the fare of the class
travelled, plus half fare of the AC class.
(b) where the
journey is performed by air, the fare of the business class; and
(c) where the
journey or any part thereof is performed by road, the fare at the rate, for the
purpose mentioned in the Travelling Allowances Rules applicable to Sindh for
the time being in force for Officers of Grade First:
Provided that if journey is
performed by personal car, the mileage allowance shall be three rupees per
Kilometre provided that--
(i) no
travelling allowance shall be admissible for journeys made during a session
between the place where the session is held and any other place; and
(ii) a member
who ordinarily resides or carries on. business at any place within five miles
of the place at which his attendance is required in connection with his duties
as a member, shall not be entitled to travelling allowance.
(2) The travelling allowance at
the rates mentioned in subsection (1) shall be admissible to a member for
journey performed during the period of adjournment of a session, if the session
is adjourned for a period of more than ten days.
(3) A member shall be entitled to
travel by air in first class while travelling abroad on an official
visit."

subsection (1), for the words "twenty-five thousand", the words

Amendment of Sindh Act VIII of 1975

ACT I OF 1995
ACT I OF 1995
SINDH REVISION OF EMOLUMENTS OF PUBLIC REPRESENTATIVES ACT, 1995
An Act to revise the salaries and
other emoluments of the holders of representative offices in the Province of
Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 30th March, 1995]
No.PAS/Legis-B-5/95, dated
30-3-1995.---The Sindh Revision of Emoluments of Public Representatives Bill,
1995 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 26th March, 1995
and assented to by Governor of Sindh on 28th March, 1995 is hereby published as
an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
4. Amendment of Sindh Act VIII of 1975.---In the Sindh Ministers
(Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975, the following amendments shall
be made; namely--
(i) in section 3-A, for the words
"three thousand and five hundred" the words "fifteen
thousand" and for the words "three thousand" the words
"five thousand" shall be substituted.
(2) in section 5, for the words
"six thousand" the words "twenty-one thousand" and for the
words "five thousand", the words 'eighteen, thousand' shall be
substituted;
(3) in section 6, for the words
"four thousand", the words "ten thousand" and for the words
"three thousand"., the words "six thousand" shall be
substituted;
(4) in section 6-A for subsection
(1), the following shall be substituted:--
"(1) An
appropriate amount and a sum of three hundred thousand rupees in a year shall
be placed at the disposal of the Chief Minister and a Minister respectively per
annum for making discretionary grants in such manner as may be
prescribed.".
(5) in section 7, in subsection
(1)---
(a) for the
proviso, the following shall be substituted:-
"Provided
that the expenditure on the furnishing of the official residence of the Chief
Minister and a Minister shall not exceed five hundred thousand rupees and one
hundred thousand rupees respectively. "
(b) in
subsection (2), for the words "eight thousand" the words 'fifteen
thousand" and for the words 'twenty thousand" the words 'sixty
thousand" shall be substituted;
(6) in section 9, in subsection
(5), in clause (a), for the words "seventy five paisas per mile" the
words "three rupees per kilometre" shall be substituted;
(7) for section 10 including
proviso, the following shall be substituted--
"10.
Daily Allowance.---The Chief Minister or a Minister while on tour shall be
entitled to draw a daily allowance of four hundred and fifty rupees per day:
Provided that
where the duration of the tour is less than eight hours one half daily
allowance shall be admissible."
(8) in section 11, for the words "one lac and twenty-five
thousand", the words "three hundred thousand" shall be
substituted;
(9) in section 12, after the
words "entitled to" the words 'First Class air fare and', shall be
inserted;
(10) after section 16, the
following shall be added:--
"16-A,
Holidaying abroad.---(1) The
Chief Minister or a Minister, as the case may be, while holidaying abroad, may
draw his full pay foreign currency, for the period of holiday spent abroad;
(2) When the
Chief Minister or a Minister, as the ease may be, is holidaying abroad and
draws his pay in foreign currency, he shall not be liable to pay income-tax,
provident fund subscription, etc. in foreign currency, if he makes arrangement
to pay such amount in rupees in Pakistan.
(3) The expenditure
in foreign exchange involved under this Act shall be
adjusted
against the foreign exchange allocation placed at the disposal of the
Government for each relevant shipping-period.
(4) Where the
pay is drawn in. foreign currency by the Chief Minister or Minister, as the
case may be, he shall not be eligible to receive foreign exchange allocation
from the State Bank of Pakistan in any other capacity."
